name: Avar Kriss' lightsaber
description: During the High Republic Era, the Jedi Master Avar Kriss utilized a green-bladed crossguard lightsaber. The weapon's hilt was sheathed in silver-white electrum, with a spiraling grip of incised green seastone, and had a physical crossguard at one end. The hilt was long-handled for a dual-handed grip.
